selection.rule: Every project of construction-progress.json (a plot-level pin in our records, at least 3 decimals, not shared, not an area centre; Sumba excluded).

source.name: Overture Maps Foundation, buildings theme, release 2026-10-21.0

datasets.Esri Community Maps: CC BY 4.0, Esri Community Maps contributors

method: Buildings of the Overture release whose footprint touches the 150 m circle around the pin (the same circle as the satellite series). cover_pct: share of the circle covered by footprints. First seen: the release in which the building's GERS id first appeared, from the Overture GERS registry, which starts at release 2025-06-25.0: a building first seen then may be older. A footprint drawn from imagery can be a few years behind the ground, and an empty circle can mean nobody has mapped it yet.
